venues.notes: Completely orphaned in OpenAlex as an EMSOFT-specific source (confirmed again 2026-07-22: the only plausible OpenAlex candidate, S4306418261 'Embedded Software', is the EMSOFT Companion/WIP track post-2016 -- a lookalike, correctly excluded). Dual publishing pattern: IEEE (even years, 10.1109/emsoft*) and ACM (odd years, 10.1145/*) for 2020-2025; 2016 was a standalone ACM proceedings (10.1145/2968478.*). 2017 and 2019 (previously flagged 'not found in Crossref') are RESOLVED as of 2026-07-22: both were published as joint ACM TECS special issues shared with CODES+ISSS and CASES (TECS 16(5s) for 2017, TECS 18(5s) for 2019, native OpenAlex source S136160450) under a generic journal container title, not a standalone EMSOFT-titled proceedings -- that's why the original container-title search missed them. EMSOFT-only subset isolated via dblp's per-conference TOC sub-sections; DOIs form a contiguous gap-free numeric span each year, registered as explicit 'dois' lists (not doi_prefix, since these are flat non-hierarchical TECS journal DOIs) for direct per-DOI harvesting. IMPORTANT UNRESOLVED FLAG (see report 'Needs human review' #1): these same ~55 DOIs are native OpenAlex records under S136160450, which is ALSO this area's separately-registered 'tecs' venue (verified, harvested by publication_year) -- a plain publication_year harvest of tecs 2017/2019 will already include these EMSOFT papers, so harvesting both venues' 2017/2019 as-is will double-count ~55 papers in any downstream aggregation. Needs a dedup/exclusion decision before Phase 1b harvest touches either venue's 2017 or 2019. All in-window years (2016-2025) now DOI-verified; 2026 not yet held (EMSOFT/ESWEEK 2026 confirmed for Oct 4-9 2026, Barcelona) -- notably its CFP states full papers will publish in IEEE TCAD, not an emsoft-branded DOI, so future collection should search TCAD for 2026+. Paper-count trend genuinely declines from ~27/yr (2016-2019) to single-digit/mid-teens (2020-2025) but is gradual, not a Crossref-coverage artifact -- all counts are DOI-verified. No EMSOFT-specific OpenAlex source exists for affiliation/institution-sniff checks on most years; per skill rule this does not block verified (and the 2017/2019 papers were spot-checked via their native TECS OpenAlex records anyway, looked fine).
